dz: 美国最高法院在“美国诉阿米斯塔德案”中裁定，控制了载有他们的船只的被俘非洲人被非法奴役。
de: The U.S. Supreme Court rules in the United States v. The Amistad case that captive Africans who had seized control of the ship carrying them had been taken into slavery illegally.

t: 威廉·亨利·哈里森死于肺炎，成为第一位在任期间去世的美国总统，并创下了任期最短的记录。副总统约…
te: William Henry Harrison dies of pneumonia, becoming the first President of the United States to die in office, and setti…
dz: 威廉·亨利·哈里森死于肺炎，成为第一位在任期间去世的美国总统，并创下了任期最短的记录。副总统约翰·泰勒接替哈里森出任总统。
de: William Henry Harrison dies of pneumonia, becoming the first President of the United States to die in office, and setting the record for the briefest administration. Vice President John Tyler succeeds Harrison as President.

t: 美国总统约翰·泰勒在威廉·亨利·哈里森去世后两天宣誓就职。
te: U.S. President John Tyler is sworn in, two days after having become president upon William Henry Harrison's death.
dz: 美国总统约翰·泰勒在威廉·亨利·哈里森去世后两天宣誓就职。
de: U.S. President John Tyler is sworn in, two days after having become president upon William Henry Harrison's death.

dz: 巴黎歌剧院芭蕾舞团在"萨勒·勒佩莱蒂埃"(Salle Le Peletier)首映.
de: The Paris Opera Ballet premieres Giselle in the Salle Le Peletier.

dz: 托马斯·伦普里耶和詹姆斯·克拉克·罗斯为测量潮汐变化在凡·迪门地的"死地"岛上刻了一块地标,这是海平面升高最早幸存的基准之一.
de: Thomas Lempriere and James Clark Ross carve a marker on the Isle of the Dead in Van Diemen's Land to measure tidal variations, one of the earliest surviving benchmarks for sea level rise.

dz: 托马斯·库克(Thomas Cook)组织从莱斯特到洛夫伯勒的第一个包出行.

de: Austria, Britain, France, Prussia and Russia conclude the London Straits Convention, which forbids warships to cross the Bosporus and Dardanelles in times of war.

dz: 巴西皇帝佩德罗二世加冕.

dz: 美国总统约翰·泰勒否决了一项要求重建美国第二银行的法案。愤怒的辉格党成员在白宫外发生骚乱，这是美国历史上白宫场地上最暴力的示威活动。
de: U.S. President John Tyler vetoes a bill which called for the re-establishment of the Second Bank of the United States. Enraged Whig Party members riot outside the White House in the most violent demonstration on White House grounds in U.S. history.

dz: 文莱苏丹国将砂拉越割让给詹姆斯·布鲁克.

de: Queen's University is founded in the Province of Canada.

dz: 詹姆斯·布赖德(James Braid)首先看到查尔斯·拉方丹(Charles Lafontaine)对动物磁学的演示,这导致了他对于他最终称之为催眠学的主题的研究.
de: James Braid first sees a demonstration of animal magnetism by Charles Lafontaine, which leads to his study of the subject he eventually calls hypnotism.
